column1: # Metal samples of R10Unorm_X6_sRGB (577) and RG10Unorm_X12_sRGB (579) over a 300 x 77 CoreVideo
# surface plane, our own probes x6es and x6hs (an Apple M4 under macOS 27.0.1; byte-identical on an
# Apple M3 Max under macOS 26.7, the -m3 runs). The texture's words are the probes' generator
# (samples.rs `padded_words`). Columns as padded_samples.tsv's: raw format, filter, address mode on
# both axes, coordinates (norm or pixel), the coordinate's two f32 bits, and the float result's red
# and green bits (blue is 0 and alpha 1 in every sample).
